title: POC scoping: cost modeling with Latitude Technologies
summary: Initial POC scoping to align on success criteria, workload sizing, and a benchmarking plan focused on per-token economics. Customer is budget-conscious; primary goals are to validate latency SLOs under target concurrency and model variants and to quantify cost per 1k tokens with batching and KV/prefix caching knobs. Agreed next steps: Redwood to send pricing + cost model spreadsheet, share benchmark test plan, and schedule a 2-hour dedicated perf run in Redwood Dedicated with sample traffic next week.
topics: workload sizing (qps, tokens per request, concurrency)
success criteria (latency p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, result quality)
batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization knobs
dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs and budget constraints
